title: Receipt of Vendor and Courier Mice
author: K.C. Kent Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xh4fj8w

steps.title: Receive Mice from Commercial Vendors
steps.instruction: Process the arrival of 'clean' mice from approved commercial vendors (Charles River Laboratory, Harlan, Taconic, The Jackson Laboratory, and JAX West).

substeps.instruction: Inspect transport crates for damage or compromise; do not accept damaged items.
Sign for receipt and place crates on transport carts.
Place receipts in the Vivarium mailbox.
Move crates to L2 for Vivarium personnel to move into the Vivarium.

steps.title: Receive Import Mice from Couriers
steps.instruction: Process the arrival of 'dirty' import mice (domestic or international), ensuring they are not transported through the 2nd Street Facility or laboratory areas.

substeps.instruction: Inspect transport crates for damage or compromise and document any damage with the courier.
Sign for receipt.
Immediately move transport crates to the Vivarium warehouse (West side of the building).
Place crates on the designated shelf in the warehouse as indicated by wall signage.
Place receipts in the Vivarium mailbox.
Immediately email mvp@ucdavis.edu and importexport@ucdavis.edu to notify them of the arrival.
If mice arrive too late to be unpacked, move them into the 112 Vivarium animal housing room and check for adequate food and water for overnight stay.

steps.title: House Commercial Vendor Mice
steps.instruction: Transfer commercial mice to their appropriate work room as soon as possible to acclimate to the light cycle, using a small animal change station and appropriate PPE.

substeps.instruction: Remove the packing slip from the transport crate.
Open the transport crate under the small animal change station and transfer mice to OptiMICE cages.
Inspect mice for gender and external wounds; verify that color, gender, age, and number match the packing slip.
Verify that the packing slip tag number matches the tag number on the MBP Mouse Work Order sheet.
House mice according to MBPVIV-20-110; if unspecified, house 5 mice per cage.
Email mvp@ucdavis.edu, mcrl@ucdavis.edu, mtgl@ucdavis.edu, and other necessary individuals to confirm the correct number, age, gender, and strain arrived.
Distribute packing slips to appropriate personnel.

steps.title: House Import Mice
steps.instruction: Transfer import mice into Room 112 (Importation) as soon as feasible, preferably towards the end of the day. Use a small animal change station and appropriate PPE.

substeps.instruction: Remove the packing slip from the transport crate.
Open the transport crate under the small animal change station and transfer mice to OptiMICE cages.
Inspect mice for gender and external wounds; verify that color, gender, age, and number match the packing slip.
Verify that the packing slip tag number matches the tag number on the MBP Mouse Work Order sheet.
Collect small tail snips for genotyping as needed.
House mice with a maximum of 5 animals per cage.

Email mvp@ucdavis.edu, mcrl@ucdavis.edu, mtgl@ucdavis.edu, importexport@ucdavis.edu, service@komp.org, mmrrc@ucdavis.edu, and other necessary individuals to confirm the correct number, age, gender, and strain arrived.
Distribute packing slips to appropriate personnel.
